route_note: Direct trains from Prague main station reach Kutná Hora in about an hour; the Sedlec ossuary is a short local bus or 20-minute walk from the station.
tour_query: Kutná Hora day trip from Prague

route_note: Direct trains and buses run from Prague to Karlovy Vary in roughly two to two and a half hours; the spa colonnade area is a short walk or local bus from the station.
tour_query: Karlovy Vary day trip from Prague

route_note: Direct buses from Prague take about three hours to Český Krumlov; the old town is a short walk from the bus station.
tour_query: Český Krumlov day trip from Prague

route_note: Frequent direct trains from Prague reach Plzeň in about an hour and a half; the historic centre and brewery are a short walk from the main station.
tour_query: Plzeň brewery day trip from Prague

route_note: Take a train or bus from Prague to Litoměřice and then a short local bus or taxi to Terezín, totaling around one and a half hours.
tour_query: Terezín memorial day trip from Prague
